_notes: Case Board v2 (Milestone 4). Placeholder story for the tech spike. The final Chapter 1 board is set later.
cards: evidence ids (from data/evidence/evidence_registry.json). Sets the order of clues in the tray.
max_pinned: how many cards the board holds at once. board_full_line is said when the player tries to pin one more.
questions[]: an open question card. It appears once the player holds any card in its answer pair. answered_by is a link_id.
links[].pair: two ids, in any order. Either two clues, or two deduction_ids (a big question). Clue + deduction is not allowed.
links[].deduction / deduction_text / deduction_id: the deduction card the pair folds into, its reading text, and its id.
line: what James says when the link locks. appear_line: what James says when a question first appears.
wrong_reactions[].pair: a wrong pair that gets its own line. Any other wrong pair uses fallback_reactions in turn.
ch01_q_lie and ch01_ded_two_lies are placeholder story. Check against the GDD Chapter 1 outline before release.
case_title + chapter_file: the paper case tag on the board (chapter number and title are read from chapter_file).
intro_lines: said once per save the first time the board opens. settled_line: said when the player tries to link a finished conclusion.
empty_notes_text / empty_notebook_text: faint pencil text on the case-notes page and in an empty notebook.
A deduction used in another link's pair is a Lead (still combines). Otherwise it is a Conclusion (finished). Worked out, not stored.
board_full_line: The board's full. Take something down.

questions.appear_line: Something about this print is wrong.
This print has been touched since it was taken.
Two lies in one photograph. What does that make it?

links.deduction_text: Two light sources and a snowbank nobody recorded. The rescue scene was staged.
links.line: Two light sources, and a snowbank nobody recorded that night. Someone built this scene.

links.deduction_text: The 2016 leaflet prints the frame without the logo. Someone edited the photo after that.
links.line: The 2016 leaflet prints the same frame, and there's no logo in it. Someone went back into this photo after that.

links.deduction_text: Staged in 1996 and altered again after 2016. Someone is still protecting this photograph.
links.line: Staged once, then fixed again twenty years later. Someone is still guarding this lie.

wrong_reactions.line: Both say fake. They don't say the same fake. One is 1996, the other is much newer.
The leaflet just reprints the photo. It can't tell me how deep the snow was.

fallback_reactions: No. Those two don't talk to each other.
Close, but that isn't the thread.
intro_lines: Pin what I've found. Tie together what belongs together.
settled_line: That one's settled. Nothing left to tie it to.
